'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jeremy G LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy G]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World]]
* '''Username:''' Jedi Jer
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
